title: Sikandar Ali v. Executive Engineer, EUDD
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Saral Srivastava, J.; Sudhanshu Chauhan, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; fresh representation to be decided in accordance with law.
headnote: Without examining merits, the Court disposed of a writ seeking a new connection on an indemnity bond under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The petitioner may file a fresh representation before the Executive Engineer, EUDD, Kalyani Devi, Allahabad, who shall consider and decide it in accordance with law within one month of receipt.
facts: The petitioner, Sikandar Ali, approached the High Court complaining that the Executive Engineer, EUDD, Kalyani Devi, Allahabad had not installed a new electricity connection despite his having submitted an indemnity bond as required under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. He had made several representations, but no action had been taken. Counsel for the respondent submitted that no useful purpose would be served by keeping the writ pending and that a direction to consider the grievance would suffice.

holding_units.holding: Without examining the merits, the Court disposed of the writ and permitted the petitioner to file a fresh representation, with a certified copy of the order, before the Executive Engineer, EUDD, Kalyani Devi, Allahabad within one month. If such a representation is filed, the Executive Engineer shall consider and decide it in accordance with law within one month of receipt. No direction to grant the connection was issued.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner is entitled to a new electricity connection on the indemnity bond submitted under the Supply Code.
Whether the respondent unlawfully failed to act on the petitioner's earlier representations.
